headline: 魁北克數學搖滾來襲
context: 來自魁北克的實驗二人組 Angine de Poitrine，在紐約 Le Poisson Rouge 開唱，以精密的數學搖滾技巧和強烈的舞台能量，獲得評論讚賞。這次他們的面具還會發光。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Le Poisson Rouge, New York The brilliantly strange experimental band’s live show is a must-see spectacle powered by glorious noise and wild flair Their masks light up now. To the extent there was a hard news event from Wednesday’s exhilarating sold-out New York debut of Angine de Poitrine , that was it. The Québécois duo went viral in corners of the internet earlier this year thanks in part to their microtonal, odd-metered take on hard-driving rock, but also because of those ostentatious costumes and masks – black and white polka dot tunics and jumpsuits with oversized papier-mache faces and exaggerated features, originally featuring golden glittery eyes and signature pyramid accoutrements. The new ones have all those same things but with the added ability to light up in a bright yellow at key moments. A small detail, to be sure, but one got the sense that the weeknight crowd was reveling in it and many others at New York’s Le Poisson Rouge (LPR) – an appropriately French-named venue given the band’s home province. Wednesday was the first of the band’s two shows at the 700-capacity basement venue renowned for its sound system and commitment to adventurous programming. Both Angine shows had been sold out for many months, ever since a video of them playing in a French studio was uploaded to KEXP’s YouTube channel and went viral. At time of writing, the video is closing in on 20m views – a remarkable tally given that the music, by mass-appeal standards, is so magnificently odd. Continue reading...

thread_text:
魁北克數學搖滾來襲

來自魁北克的實驗二人組 Angine de Poitrine，在紐約 Le Poisson Rouge 開唱，這次他們的面具還會發光。

評論形容，這場演出以精密的數學搖滾技巧和強烈的舞台能量，撐起一場噪音與狂放兼具的視覺奇觀。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 11 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
